content.study:
Section 29B — Fast track procedure

Section 29B permits parties to agree in writing to a fast-track arbitration. The tribunal is constituted in the manner prescribed by the section, the proceeding is intended to be document-focused, and the award is subject to the statutory fast-track time limit and related procedural conditions.

The fast-track/confidentiality provision must be applied according to its exact statutory conditions and exceptions.
